How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Momcozy · AI says:

Absolutely—here’s how to get the best results from your M5 Smart Bra Bundle! Focus on the fit, seal, and routine:

Assemble it correctly: Attach the duckbill valve to the flange base with the opening downward. Snap the cup onto the front cover, flatten the silicone diaphragm against the pump body without creases, and clip on the motor until it clicks.
Check the flange: Center your nipple, leaving about 1–2 mm of clearance. Your areola should stay out of the tunnel, and your nipple should not rub the walls.
Create a seal: Press the cup gently but firmly against your breast, lean slightly forward while positioning, then sit upright and tuck it into your bra. A snug pumping bra helps maintain suction.
Pump comfortably: Use stimulation mode for the full 2 minutes. Then switch to expression mode and increase suction one notch at a time until you feel firm, rhythmic tugging without pain or pinching—never use maximum suction. Continue comfortably for about 8 minutes; a full session is typically 20–25 minutes if you have not breastfed beforehand.
If you breastfeed first, finish with 2 minutes of Marmet hand expression to help collect higher-fat hindmilk and improve drainage.
Remove safely: Lean forward, break the seal at the cup edge, remove the pump, and pour out the milk right away.
For weak suction, recheck assembly, flange size, and bra fit. Clean all milk-contact parts after every use, and replace worn silicone parts or valves regularly.

Correct assembly, a snug seal, 2 full minutes of stimulation, and gradual suction adjustment are the keys to better output!
